description:
Get one graded book with every forecast and its outcome. A book (or batch) is one trading day's full S&P 500
    slate, served once its long picks are fully graded, so other rows can still have null outcomes. Use
    list_resolved_batches to find the date, verify_batch for the book's proof and get_book_portfolio for its portfolio.
    An ungraded or unknown date is an error.

trading_date.description: The book's trading date, as YYYY-MM-DD. list_resolved_batches gives the graded dates.
trading_date.title: Trading Date

name: get_resolved_batch
title: One book
